actions.command:
cat <<'EOF' > plot_script.py
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Define the equation: (z - 4) * (z - 6) * (z - 8) + 90
def equation(z):
    return (z - 4) * (z - 6) * (z - 8) + 90

# Generate x values from 0 to 11
x = np.linspace(0, 11, 1000)
y = equation(x)

# Create the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots()

# Plot the function with blue line and thickness 2
ax.plot(x, y, color='blue', linewidth=2)

# Shade the region between 3 and 10
ax.axvspan(3, 10, color='lightblue', alpha=0.5)

# Add text in the center of the shaded region
text_x = (3 + 10) / 2  # Center of the shaded region
text_y = equation(text_x)  # Corresponding y value
text = r"\int_{3}^{10} [(z - 4)(z - 6)(z - 8) + 90] dz"
ax.text(text_x, text_y, text, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, bbox=dict(facecolor='white', alpha=0.7))

# Customize the plot
ax.set_xlim(0, 11)
ax.set_ylim(0, None)  # Start y-axis from 0

# Add axis labels
ax.set_xlabel('z')
ax.set_ylabel('f(z)')

# Add x-ticks at 3 and 10
ax.set_xticks([3, 10])
ax.set_xticklabels(['3', '10'])

# Remove y-ticks
ax.set_yticks([])

# Hide top and right borders
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Save the plot as figure.png
plt.savefig('figure.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.close()
EOF
